systems.notes: First strict protein-only system in v2. No exact or >=90% full-length neighbor was found among 15,843 official Protein2PAM Cas9 training rows, and the exact sequence was absent from current project corpus TSVs. Sensitivity screening found a closest official-training neighbor at 0.89441624 identity, only 0.00558376 below the preregistered cutoff, so this is a boundary-independent rather than distant-OOD case. No natural spacer-target collection is registered, so this system is not paired-evidence eligible.
